content.thinking: הדף מדבר על מדד מניות, ומדובר במדד ת"א-125 בבורסה בתל אביב, שהוא כבר נבחר כיעד. אני ממשיך לברר את העלויות והדרכים להשקיע בו, עם 10,000 היום ו-500 בחודש.

ההשקעה הציגה 70,000 ₪ שהופקדו ו-86,045 ₪ צפויים בעוד 10 שנים, אבל אינני בטוח מאיפה מגיע שיעור ה-7% ומה פירוש "דמי משמרת". מתוך הפירוט עולה שהקרן היא אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125, והחשבון מנוהל על ידי פסגות ניירות ערך.
Psagot is cheapest at 86,045, while Hapoalim's account costs 6,530 against Psagot's 1,049, which means my bank charges several times more. I'm not counting the arrows on these pages.

The fund's minus sign and the 86,045 ₪ projection are the main points, and I'm not sure about the Psagot option, so I'm checking with the bank before acting on any of it. The narration itself is the user's own reflection, so I'll just say that.

input.answer: If I do it, I'd do it through Psagot with the fund the page picked, "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)". The page says I'd have about 86,045 ₪ in today's money after 10 years, on 70,000 ₪ put in (10,000 at the start and 500 a month), but I won't do anything until I ask you or the bank. There's a minus next to that fund and I don't know Psagot.

stuck.why: Title says 'להשקיע במדד' and then English buttons (MSCI, S&P 500). To me מדד is the price index, so I nearly felt this page wasn't for me. Only the ת"א-125 button and the line about the 125 companies kept me going.
I don't know where 7% comes from or whether I should change it. The boxes come with sliders, and I left everything as it was, including 10,000 'סכום היום' that I didn't choose.
'−1,030 ₪' with a minus made me back away from that option without understanding it.
'−0.04% בשנה · שנה אחת' with a minus right on the fund it chose for me. I couldn't tell if it means the fund loses money. That's where I stopped.
